hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiEth custom swap curve, bypassing concentrated liquidity via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. On each swap it takes the input from the PoolManager, wraps or unwraps ETH via the phiEth contract, and settles the output — effectively an on-chain ETH wrapper as a v4 hook. Direct liquidity addition to the pool is blocked.
